name: UQ International Student Scholarship
summary: One-year support for international undergraduates at UQ facing temporary, unexpected financial hardship.
who: International students enrolled full-time in a UQ undergraduate program.
Facing temporary and unexpected financial hardship.
how: Apply through the scholarship page. Applications open in December 2026 and close in February 2027.
catches: The amount depends on the fund's income each year, so none is published.
Not available if you've had UQ Financial Hardship Assistance Scheme support that year, or hold a similar scholarship.
